entries.title: Add your own request headers to a custom provider
entries.body: A custom API provider can send the extra headers your organization's server needs on every request, such as a team ID or a gateway token. A header marked Secret is masked and never shown again. A server that checks its own header instead of a key can now go without one.

picture.alt: The Extra request headers section of a custom API provider, with a visible X-Org-Id header and a masked secret X-Gateway-Token header
